The Amstel front, from the 2018-05-08 panorama aimed thumbnail (w04-6): two buildings in one pand. walls[0] (3DBAG panel 41, 13.1 m): a five-storey brown-brick canal house with white stone bands at sill and lintel level, a white cornice and parapet with consoles, red-framed windows with top lights on three axes and an entrance with a stone stoop in the left axis. walls[1] (panels 87, 38, 33, 31, 26: the curved front faceted by 3DBAG): the polychrome hotel block, red brick with yellow stucco bands and diamond panels, red-framed two-light windows, a glazed ground floor behind grey stone piers and the hotel entrance under a wide canopy lettered EDEN HOTEL.

The canopy did not fit the 5.7 m entrance facet (the kit's canopy runs 0.6 m past the entrance on both sides), so EDEN HOTEL is lettered on a fascia board over the entrance instead. closedBands: the 3DBAG faces of the canal house stand a few cm out of one plane, so string courses and the cornice are closed solids.

Not modelled (the photos show them): the canopy over the hotel entrance, the yellow stucco bands and diamond panels of the hotel block (one string course per storey instead), the stone consoles and pediment of the canal house cornice, the stone stoop and its railings, the lantern, the flagpole on the hotel roof, the Gothic-revival neighbour at the corner (another pand).
